pages.title: Crystalline Matrix Ingot
pages.text: A superposition crystal locked inside a Cherenkov lattice and fixed there by the light of a nether star. The ingot is glassy but metal-heavy, and its interior shows several overlapping lattices at once, none of them willing to collapse into the others.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Superposition crystals collapse when observed, so I sealed one inside a Cherenkov lattice and bathed it in the light of a dead star on the Extreme Assembly Table. The lattices froze mid-superposition.
Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Entanglement.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot, Transfinite Weave.
